recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No current core FHIR source edit is needed for FHIR-20409 unless the external publisher regresses profile comparison link generation or a separate process chooses to patch old published pages.
issue_request: FHIR-20409 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction, raised against STU3 and applied for R5, reporting that generated "compare to stu3" links on profiled Observation pages such as bp pointed at non-resolving URLs like http://hl7.org/fhir/STU3/bp instead of the resolving http://hl7.org/fhir/STU3/bp.html.
initial_application: The Jira comment records R4 commit a00b4aa155 and R5 commit ed006b5. The R4 commit explicitly mentions GF#20409 and changed the old Java publisher's rellink handling so profile filenames without .html were emitted with .html, with matching validation for other page paths; ed006b5 carried the same publisher-side behavior forward for R5. Those Java publisher files are no longer present in this core source checkout.
additional_context: Observation and the blood-pressure profile source remain in current build scope, but the current generated CI page for bp.html compares against R4, R5, and the last ballot, and each rendered comparison href targets an .html page. A current source search found no generated or source link to the broken STU3/bp target; the remaining STU3 links in source are unrelated explicit .html links. FHIR-23032 was fixed by the same historical commits for datatype usage links and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The bad STU3 comparison URL was a historical generated-output problem fixed in the old publisher, and the current core build output for the active bp profile no longer reproduces it.

related_jiras.note: The same R4/R5 commits also fixed datatype usage links; FHIR-23032 is already represented on the combined branch by its own no-change audit.
